messages.subject: For Bader Al-Kharafi | Telecom, AI growth and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Zain Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Bader Al-Kharafi, Vice Chairman and Group Chief Executive Officer.

Zain's growth across the Middle East and Africa increasingly spans 5G, AI, fintech and digital infrastructure, all of which require disciplined government, regulatory and stakeholder alignment. That interface closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, regional stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Zain's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Zain Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
